explanation: GC external-pointer visitors now identify ArrayBufferExtension entries by the table entry's actual tag, including cross-tag handles. Detaching a zero-length resizable ArrayBuffer additionally frees its extension while the sweeper still tracks it. The parent ASan d8 exits normally on pocs/probe.js; the rebuilt edited d8 reports a heap-use-after-free in ArrayBufferSweeper::SweepListFull.
